summary: Proof-worth ownership for the accepted M4 complete-AX authority, milestone allocation, current internal observation engine, and later public/native delivery boundaries.

entries.contract: ADR 0045 plus the capability and authority ledgers freeze the exact native system/application/window/current-Observation-Ref element/AOS display-composite root taxonomy; immutable retained snapshots, refs, deterministic traversal, separate traversal/page bounds, opaque snapshot-bound cursors, visited/matched/emitted/frontier truth, raw filter and closed typed AX value outcomes, distinct attribute/parameterized/settable/action projections, Observation Ref versus Locator separation, operation-plane raw actions and readback, per-PID process-generation AXObserver lifecycle with callback-receipt sequence/time and no invented source time, loss/frontier/no-replay recovery, zero-residual cleanup, ax_global_points and target_local_points plus three distinct pixel spaces, exact observable ScreenCaptureKit binding with no fictional generation or platform identity, landed M3 geometry prerequisite, M4/M5/M6/M10 ownership boundaries, exhaustive exact-file current/proposed/generated owners with no broad source-directory claim or proposed-file existence preclaim, dependency-ordered M4A through M4F delivery, and production-attached behavioral proof before product completion.
entries.worth: This includes a negative mutation that injects complete-AX re-observation as M4's transform prerequisite and must fail. It also fails on fictional ScreenCaptureKit generation, SDK preclaim, display-composite-as-platform-root wording, missing or broad production owners, proposed owners preclaimed as existing, static-only behavioral proof, Observation Ref/Locator collapse, lost per-PID observer lifecycle, or reassignment of app lifecycle, window/menu lifecycle, or CoreGraphics input posting back into M4.
entries.guard: Static authority and owner-allocation proof only; it does not execute production AX traversal, actions, observers, coordinate transforms, ./aos, daemon, Swift/native builds, UI, browser, TCC, packaging, or live capability sampling.

entries.contract: The internal M4 AX observation engine uses exact system, application, window, current Observation Ref element, and AOS display-composite roots; injected double process-generation sampling; deterministic parent-first traversal with cycle versus duplicate edge truth; closed raw values and typed outcomes; independent traversal, value, page, expiry, and retention bounds; immutable no-reobserve snapshots; stateful opaque lookup tokens; one externally owned serialized store; and exactly-once retained-handle release.
entries.worth: This executes the three production Swift owners, validates their production JSON projection against the closed internal schema, and fails on request-local store ownership, generation drift admission, filter pruning, relationship-order drift, copied paging state, token authority decoding, cross-snapshot or consumed-token reuse, retention leaks, or public daemon and CLI preclaims.
entries.guard: Offline disposable fake platform, generation, clock, and identity seams only; no ./aos, build, daemon, public command route, native UI, browser, TCC, AXObserver, raw AX mutation, coordinate binding, packaging, or live capability sampling.
